newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICAN POLICE ARREST COCAINE SMUGGLER AT AIRPORT.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICAN POLICE ARREST COCAINE SMUGGLER AT AIRPORT.

text.p: South African police said on Tuesday they had arrested a man at Johannesburg International Airport carrying three kilogrammes of cocaine worth about 900,000 rand ($200,000).

The South African, who had flown in from Miami in the United States, had tried to smuggle the drugs through customs in a pair of boots, two cans, four Johnson & Johnson powder holders and four underarm deodorant cans.
